props.name: cancel
props.description:
Optional cancel button rendered below the list (iOS pattern). Pass a
string to override the label. Linear-style sheets typically omit this.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Auto-close after an item is selected.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional supporting copy rendered below the title.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Tapping the overlay or dragging down closes the sheet.

props.name: handle
props.description: Show the drag handle at the top of the sheet.

props.name: items
props.description:
Items to render. Flat array, OR nested array where each inner array
becomes a section separated by a thin divider (Linear-style grouping).

props.name: overlay
props.description: Render the dim overlay behind the sheet.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional uppercase section heading rendered above the list.

slots.name: default
slots.description:
Trigger content. `SheetTrigger` opens the sheet on tap; do NOT bind a
`@tap` handler on the slotted child that also sets the open state — use
`v-model:open` (or `v-model`) instead.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Header region — replaces the built-in title / description block.

slots.name: item-leading
slots.type: { item: ActionSheetItem; index: number; iconColor: string; }
slots.description: Custom rendering for an item's leading slot. Receives `iconColor` so custom icons can match the item's resolved foreground.

slots.name: item-label
slots.description: Custom rendering for an item's label.

slots.name: item-trailing
slots.type: { item: ActionSheetItem; index: number; iconColor: string; }
slots.description: Custom rendering for an item's trailing slot. Receives `iconColor` so custom icons can match the trailing foreground.
